downloads.title: Download a model from Hugging Face
downloads.intro: Enter a model name from Hugging Face. The platform downloads it into the model directory; when it finishes you can create a model service.
downloads.repoHelp: Format "organization/model". You can also paste a huggingface.co URL.
downloads.dirHelp: Folder name under the model directory. Defaults to the model name.
downloads.stalled: no progress for {{time}}; still downloading and will continue when the network recovers
downloads.queuedHint: Queued: models are downloaded one at a time
downloads.cancelBody: Cancel downloading {{repo}}? Files downloaded so far will be deleted.
downloads.leftover: Temporary files couldn't be removed automatically; delete them on the Spark: {{path}}

warnings.TARGET_EXISTS: "{{dir}}" already exists in the model directory. Choose another folder name.
warnings.NO_CONFIG: This repo has no config.json, so the platform can't use it (it may not be a regular language model).
warnings.NO_WEIGHTS: This repo has no safetensors weights.
warnings.NO_SAFETENSORS_BIN_ONLY: This repo only has legacy .bin weights. The platform only downloads safetensors; look for a safetensors version of the same model.
warnings.DISK_SPACE_LOW: Not enough free disk space (at least 10% must remain free after the download).
warnings.REMOTE_CODE: This model needs "Trust remote code". Turn it on in the advanced settings when creating the service.
warnings.GATED_OK: This model requires accepting a license; your Hugging Face token will be used.

errors.REPO_ID_INVALID: Invalid model name. Use "organization/model", e.g. Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
errors.TARGET_DIR_INVALID: Folder names may only contain letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-"
errors.REPO_NOT_FOUND: Model not found on Hugging Face (wrong name, or a private model that needs a token)
errors.REPO_GATED: Accept this model's license on the Hugging Face website first, then set a Hugging Face token
errors.HUB_UNREACHABLE: Can't reach Hugging Face. Check that the Spark has internet access.
errors.NETWORK: The network dropped during the download. You can retry.
errors.NO_CONFIG: Download finished but config.json is missing; files were deleted
errors.DOWNLOAD_BLOCKED: Can't download yet. Resolve the issues above first.

hfToken.title: Hugging Face token
hfToken.intro: Needed for license-gated models (e.g. Llama) or private models. Create a token with "Read" permission at huggingface.co → Settings → Access Tokens.
hfToken.cleared: Token set on the web cleared

apiBase.title: External API address
apiBase.intro: The API address external systems (internal apps, OpenCode, etc.) connect to. It is shown on the Gateway page and in each model service's "How to use".
apiBase.autoHelp: Derived from the address you used to open this page. Currently detected:
apiBase.manualHelp: Use when you have a domain name, a reverse proxy, or a public IP different from this page.
apiBase.deployNote: Currently using the deployment setting (PUBLIC_API_BASE in deploy/.env): {{value}}. Choose an option above and save to override it here.
apiBase.invalid: Invalid format. Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:4000/v1

testFail.timeout: Connection timed out: check the IP, port and firewall
testFail.network: Can't connect: wrong address, port not open, or blocked by a firewall

warnings.API_BASE_LOCALHOST: This address only works on the Spark itself. From other computers, open this page using the Spark's IP, or set the address manually in Settings.
warnings.GATEWAY_LOCAL_BIND: The Gateway only accepts local connections (GATEWAY_BIND=127.0.0.1); other computers can't call it.
warnings.API_BASE_NOT_V1: The address usually ends with /v1. Please double-check it.

common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy; please select it manually

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.tokenPlaceholder: Enter the admin token set during deployment

health.gateway_unreachable: Gateway is not running (it may be restarting)
health.gateway_db: Gateway can't connect to its database
health.runtime_error: Runtime problem (can't reach the container runtime)

dashboard.gatewayDoctor: An admin can run scripts/doctor.sh on the Spark to diagnose
dashboard.needKey: Need an API key? Create one on the Gateway page
dashboard.externalServices: Detected {{count}} service(s) not managed by this platform. They can't be stopped from here.
dashboard.externalServicesMem: Detected {{count}} service(s) not managed by this platform, using about {{size}} of memory. They can't be stopped from here.
dashboard.autostartRunning: Starting auto-start model services one by one ({{done}}/{{total}})
dashboard.autostartFailed: Auto-start on boot: {{count}} did not succeed

models.title: Models
models.deleteBody: Delete "{{name}}"? This removes {{path}} ({{size}}) from disk and can't be undone.
models.deleteInUse: Model services are using this model. Delete those services first.
models.deleteNotLocal: Only models in the model directory can be deleted here
models.emptyDownload: You can download models directly from Hugging Face:
models.empty: No models in the model directory yet.
models.emptyHint: Put model folders (with config.json and weights) in {{path}}, then click "Rescan".

services.title: Model Services
services.intro: A model service (instance) is a running model you can call through the API.

confirm.stopBody: External systems won't be able to call "{{name}}" until it's started again. Stop it?
confirm.restartBody: External systems can't call "{{name}}" while it restarts. Restart it?
confirm.deleteBody: This can't be undone (model files are kept). Delete "{{name}}"?
confirm.deleteRunning: Stop a running model service before deleting it.

wizard.title: Create model service
wizard.intro: A model service (instance) is a running model you can call through the API.
wizard.selectPreset: What will this model mainly be used for?
wizard.advancedHint: Usually no need to change these
wizard.savedOnly: Settings saved; start it any time
wizard.leaveConfirm: Settings not yet created will be lost. Leave anyway?

long_context.label: Long documents
long_context.description: Read long documents or lots of code

high_throughput.label: High throughput
high_throughput.description: Many concurrent users (currently close to Balanced)

explain.model_limit: The model supports up to {{value}}, so {{value}} is used
explain.preset_limit: This purpose caps it at {{value}} (the model supports {{model_max}})
explain.unknown_fallback: Not enough model information; using the safe value {{value}}
explain.from_source: Set to {{value}} based on this machine
explain.capped: Uses the model limit, capped at {{value}}
explain.fit: This model needs about {{need_gb}} GB; with {{headroom}}x headroom, about {{reserve_gb}} GB is reserved
explain.fit_unknown: Model size or host memory unknown; using the safe value {{value}}

display_name.label: Service name
display_name.help: Only used to identify it on screen; name it however you like.

served_model_name.label: API model name
served_model_name.help: The model name external systems use when calling. Lowercase letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-" only.

max_model_len.label: Max conversation length
max_model_len.help: Maximum tokens in one conversation (input plus output). Longer uses more memory.

gpu_memory_utilization.label: Memory ratio
gpu_memory_utilization.help: At startup this fraction of the machine's total memory (shared by GPU and system) is reserved up front; the extra is used to serve more conversations at once. A higher ratio leaves less room for other model services.

quantization.label: Quantization
quantization.help: Usually leave on "Auto"; the platform detects it from the model files.

dtype.label: Data type (dtype)
dtype.help: Numeric precision used for computation. Usually auto.

trust_remote_code.label: Trust remote code
trust_remote_code.help: Some models need to run Python code shipped in the model folder. Only enable for models from sources you trust.
trust_remote_code.warning: This runs code from the model folder. Make sure the model source is trustworthy.

host_port.label: Direct host port (debugging)
host_port.help: Usually not needed. External systems should call through the Gateway.

extra_args.label: Extra launch arguments
extra_args.help: Appended to the vLLM launch command.
extra_args.warning: Compatibility isn't guaranteed; this may cause startup to fail.

autostart.label: Start this model service when the Spark boots
autostart.help: After a reboot, services start one by one automatically.

warnings.NAME_INVALID: API model name "{{name}}" is not valid
warnings.NAME_DUPLICATE: API model name "{{name}}" is already used by another model service
warnings.CONTEXT_TOO_SMALL: Max conversation length must be at least {{min}}
warnings.CONTEXT_MODEL_UNKNOWN: The model's maximum conversation length is unknown; please check the value
warnings.CONTEXT_EXCEEDS_MODEL: Max conversation length {{value}} exceeds the model limit {{max}}
warnings.MEM_UTIL_OUT_OF_RANGE: Memory ratio must be between {{min}} and {{max}}
warnings.REMOTE_CODE_LIKELY_REQUIRED: This model may need "Trust remote code" to start
warnings.EXTRA_ARGS_INVALID: Extra launch arguments are malformed (unbalanced quotes)
warnings.EXTRA_ARGS_FORBIDDEN: Extra launch arguments can't include platform-managed arguments: {{args}}
warnings.EXTRA_ARGS_PRESENT: Extra launch arguments are set; compatibility isn't guaranteed
warnings.HOST_PORT_INVALID: Port {{port}} is outside the allowed range (1024–65535)
warnings.HOST_PORT_CONFLICT: Port {{port}} is already used by another model service
warnings.WEIGHTS_EXCEED_TOTAL: Model weights are larger than this machine's total memory and can't be loaded
warnings.WEIGHTS_EXCEED_BUDGET: Memory ratio too low: {{budget}} reserved can't even hold the {{weights}} of model weights. Set it to at least {{min_ratio}}
warnings.ESTIMATE_EXCEEDS_BUDGET: Estimated memory exceeds this service's quota; startup may fail
warnings.TOTAL_UTIL_HIGH: Other running services already use {{others}}, {{combined}} combined; startup may fail
warnings.AVAILABLE_LOW: This service's quota is larger than currently available memory; startup may fail
warnings.PAGE_CACHE_HIGH: A lot of memory is in system cache, so less is immediately free; if startup fails, try again shortly
warnings.AUTOSTART_TOTAL_HIGH: All auto-start services together use {{combined}}; they may not all start on boot
warnings.RESERVES_UP_FRONT: About {{budget}} ({{ratio}}) of memory is reserved as soon as it starts, regardless of actual use
warnings.RESERVE_MUCH_LARGER: The reserved {{budget}} is much more than the {{estimate}} this model needs. Lower the memory ratio if you want to run other models alongside it

estimate.title: Estimated memory
estimate.disclaimer: For reference only; actual usage is determined at startup

detail.apiKeyHint: Use an API key created on the Gateway page
detail.testDefault: Hello, please introduce yourself in one sentence.
detail.testOnlyReady: You can test once the model service is ready and published
detail.gatewayRegistered: External systems can call it as "{{name}}"
detail.gatewayFailed: Not published to the Gateway yet; external systems can't call it for now
detail.gatewayNone: Model service isn't running, so it isn't published to the Gateway
detail.queuedTitle: Queued: waiting for another model service to finish loading
detail.queuedHint: To keep memory calculations correct, only one model loads at a time. It starts automatically when the previous one finishes.
detail.loadingHint: Large models can take several minutes to load the first time. This is normal.
detail.slowHint: Taking longer than expected; check the logs
detail.restartRequired: These changes take effect after a restart. External calls are interrupted during the restart.
detail.renameWarning: External systems using the old name "{{name}}" will no longer be able to call it

events.queued: Queued (waiting for another model to finish loading)

logs.title: Logs
logs.streamEnded: Log stream ended (the service may have stopped)

external.title: Services not managed by this platform
external.intro: These programs also use GPU memory but weren't created by this console. The platform never stops or changes them; it only counts them when estimating memory.
external.total: Using about {{size}} of GPU memory in total

hint.vllm: This looks like a manually started vLLM. To stop it, run on the Spark: docker stop {{name}}
hint.compose: Started by docker compose project "{{project}}". To stop it, run docker compose down in that project's directory.
hint.container: To stop it, run on the Spark: docker stop {{name}}
hint.process: This program runs directly on the host (not in a container). Ask whoever started it.

modelDetails.title: Model details
modelDetails.presets: Recommended settings per purpose (calculated for this machine)

gateway.title: Gateway (external API entry)
gateway.howTo: External systems (internal apps, OpenCode, etc.) use: API address + an API key created below + model name.
gateway.masterKeyNote: The Gateway master key exists only in the deployment settings. It's never shown here and shouldn't be given to external systems.

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Give each external system its own API key so you can revoke them individually.
keys.name: Name
keys.nameHelp: Identifies who uses it, e.g. "OpenCode - Alex" or "Internal App A"
keys.onlyOnce: This is the only time the full key is shown. Once closed it can't be viewed again, so copy and store it now.
keys.savedConfirm: I've stored the key somewhere safe
keys.revokeBody: Systems using "{{name}}" will immediately lose access, and this can't be undone. Revoke it?
keys.rotateBody: A new key with the same name and limits will be created, and the old "{{name}}" is disabled immediately. Systems using the old key must switch to the new one. Continue?
keys.rotatedNote: The old key is disabled. Update the systems that use it with the new key.

settings.title: Settings
settings.runtimeHelp: These are fixed at deployment. Change them only by editing deploy/.env on the Spark and running docker compose up -d.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.intro: These settings take effect immediately; no platform restart needed.
advanced.timeoutHelp: If a model service isn't ready within this time after starting, it's marked as failed. Large models can take a long time to load the first time. Range {{lo}}–{{hi}} minutes (default {{def}}). Applies on the next start.
advanced.timeoutRange: Enter a whole number between {{lo}} and {{hi}}
advanced.endpointHelp: Leave blank to connect to huggingface.co directly. If the Spark can't reach Hugging Face, enter a mirror URL (e.g. https://hf-mirror.com). Applies to the next download.
advanced.endpointInvalid: Invalid format. Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://

testFail.timeout: The Spark timed out connecting to {{url}}
testFail.network: The Spark can't reach {{url}} (wrong address or no network)
testFail.not_hf: {{url}} responded, but doesn't look like a Hugging Face–compatible URL

advanced.verboseHelp: When on, "Platform backend" on the Logs page also shows the page's status polling every few seconds, so logs grow faster. Keep it off normally.

errors.INSTANCE_RUNNING: Stop the running model service first

errors.MODEL_NOT_DELETABLE: This model can't be deleted from the platform
errors.MODEL_DELETE_PERMISSION: Failed to delete model files: permission denied ({{error}})
errors.DOWNLOAD_ACTIVE: This model is still downloading; cancel it in the downloads panel first

OOM.title: Model failed to start: not enough memory
OOM.description: This model with the current settings needs more memory than was reserved (memory ratio too low, or max conversation length too long).

suggest.raise_ratio: Raise the memory ratio to {{value}}% and retry
suggest.reduce_context: Reduce max conversation length to {{value}} and retry

GPU_MEMORY_IN_USE.title: Model failed to start: memory is used by other programs
GPU_MEMORY_IN_USE.description: Only about {{free_gib}} GB was free at startup, but these settings reserve {{requested_gib}} GB. Usually another model service is using the memory.

suggest.stop_others: View and stop other running services
suggest.lower_ratio: Lower the memory ratio to {{value}}% and retry

MEMORY_PRECHECK.title: Memory may be insufficient
MEMORY_PRECHECK.description: The pre-start check found memory may not be enough.

MODEL_NOT_FOUND.title: Model files not found
MODEL_NOT_FOUND.description: The model folder may have been moved or deleted.

MODEL_UNSUPPORTED.title: This model architecture isn't supported yet
MODEL_UNSUPPORTED.description: The current vLLM version can't load this model.

REMOTE_CODE_REQUIRED.title: This model needs "Trust remote code"
REMOTE_CODE_REQUIRED.description: This model must run code shipped in its folder in order to load.

suggest.enable: Turn on "Trust remote code" (make sure the source is trustworthy)

HEALTH_TIMEOUT.title: Startup timed out
HEALTH_TIMEOUT.description: The model didn't finish loading within {{timeout_min}} minutes. Large models can take longer the first time; extend the model load timeout in Settings → Advanced settings and retry.

CRASHED.title: Model service stopped unexpectedly
CRASHED.description: The model service exited while starting or running. Check the logs for the reason.

PORT_CONFLICT.title: Direct host port is in use
PORT_CONFLICT.description: The configured port is already used by another program.

IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Runtime image not found
IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE.description: Ask an admin to check that the vLLM image has been pulled.

GPU_UNAVAILABLE.title: GPU unavailable
GPU_UNAVAILABLE.description: The container couldn't get a GPU. Check the host.

DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE.title: Can't reach the container runtime
DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE.description: Check the Docker service on the host.

CONTAINER_MISSING.title: Model service was removed externally
CONTAINER_MISSING.description: The service's container was deleted outside the platform.

GATEWAY_UNREACHABLE.title: Can't reach the Gateway
GATEWAY_UNREACHABLE.description: The model is ready, but the Gateway isn't running (it may be restarting or unable to reach its database). The platform republishes automatically once the Gateway is back; an admin can run scripts/doctor.sh on the Spark to diagnose.

GATEWAY_PORT_IN_USE.title: Gateway port is used by another program
GATEWAY_PORT_IN_USE.description: Stop the program using the port.

TEST_TIMEOUT.title: Test message timed out
TEST_TIMEOUT.description: The model responded too slowly; try again later.

AUTOSTART_SKIPPED_MEMORY.title: Auto-start on boot skipped
AUTOSTART_SKIPPED_MEMORY.description: The pre-start check found the settings can't be used.

errors.PROVIDER_NAME_TAKEN: That name is already in use
errors.TEST_MODEL_REQUIRED: Enter a model to test with
errors.NAME_DUPLICATE: That name is already used by another model
errors.ROUTING_TARGET_INVALID: Fallback model doesn't exist or is the same as the source

keyLimits.title: Limits (optional)
keyLimits.intro: Leave everything blank for no limits. Spend only accrues for cloud models or local models with a price set.
keyLimits.budgetHelp: The key is rejected once it reaches the limit
keyLimits.periodHelp: Resets to zero at the end of each period

price.title: Price (optional)
price.help: Local models are free by default (0). To compare costs with the cloud or charge back internally, set a virtual price and usage statistics will compute spend from it. Takes effect immediately and only affects later requests.

cloud.title: Cloud Models
cloud.intro: Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible service, and cloud models appear next to local models on the same external API, callable with the same API keys. Provider API keys are stored encrypted by the Gateway (LiteLLM).

typeHelp.gemini: The Gemini API from Google AI Studio.
typeHelp.openai_compatible: Any service offering an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions, e.g. Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or another vLLM.

provider.title: Cloud providers
provider.name: Name
provider.apiKeyOptional: Leave blank if the service doesn't need a key
provider.apiKeyKeep: Current: {{masked}}. Leave blank to keep it
provider.testModelHelp: Enter a model name this service provides
provider.storage: The API key is only sent to the Gateway and stored encrypted. Afterwards only a masked version is shown; the full key can't be viewed again.
provider.created: Added "{{name}}". Now choose the models to offer.
provider.deleteBody: Deleting "{{name}}" also removes its {{n}} cloud model(s); systems using them will no longer be able to call them. Delete it?

model.title: Cloud models
model.intro: Once added, a model can be called through the external API; its name is the model value used in requests.
model.modelHelp: Pick from the list or type a model ID
model.listPrice: List price: input ${{input}} / output ${{output}} (per million tokens)
model.name: External model name
model.nameHelp: The name external systems use; must not clash with a local model
model.nameInvalid: Only letters, digits and . _ : / - are allowed
model.customPriceHelp: By default spend is calculated from LiteLLM's built-in list prices
model.customPriceCompat: OpenAI-compatible services have no built-in price; without one, spend is recorded as 0
model.deleteBody: Systems using "{{name}}" will no longer be able to call it, and related fallback rules are removed too. Continue?

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.intro: When a call to a model fails, automatically try other models in order. Typical use: switch to a cloud model when a local model fails or is stopped.
fallback.pickTargets: Choose one or more fallback models
fallback.needTwo: At least two models (local services or cloud models) are needed to set up a fallback.
fallback.stoppedNote: When a local service is stopped, requests to it are also routed to its first fallback model, and go back to it automatically once it restarts.
fallback.retriesHelp: How many times to retry the same model before falling back (0–5)

usage.title: Usage
usage.intro: All requests through the external API (local and cloud models). Data is delayed by about 1 minute.
usage.spendNote: Local models count as 0 unless a price is set

adminToken.title: Admin token
adminToken.intro: The token used to sign in to this console.
adminToken.note: After changing it, DGXSP_ADMIN_TOKEN in deploy/.env no longer works (the web setting takes precedence). Every signed-in browser must sign in again. See the README if you forget the token.
adminToken.doneBody: Sign in again with the new token.

err.TOKEN_WEAK: The new token is too short or contains spaces
err.TOKEN_SAME: The new token is the same as the current one
